title: Dijkstra's shortest path algorithm in Python - GeeksforGeeks
snippet: The algorithm assigns distance values to all vertices initialized as infinite, sets distance 0 for the source vertex, and repeatedly picks the vertex with minimum distance not yet visited, updating its neighbors' distances.

title: Implementing the Dijkstra Algorithm in Python: A Step-by-Step Tutorial | DataCamp
snippet: A common approach uses Python's heapq module as a priority queue: distances are initialized to infinity except the start node (0), and the algorithm pops the minimum-distance node, updating neighbors until the queue is empty.
